items.name: tokens
items.title: Cubby UI tokens
items.description: Design tokens of Cubby UI as two stylesheets: the custom properties themselves (dark canon plus a light theme) and the Tailwind v4 @theme inline mapping that turns them into utilities.
items.author: Sergey Orshak

items.name: cn
items.title: cn
items.description: Слияние классов Tailwind с поправкой на текстовые стили Cubby UI: без неё tailwind-merge принимает text-ui-md за цвет и молча выбрасывает кегль, когда рядом стоит text-text-1.
items.author: Sergey Orshak
items.docs: Отдельный файл lib/cn.ts, а не правка lib/utils.ts: стандартный cn из shadcn init остаётся на месте, компоненты Cubby UI импортируют @/lib/cn.

items.name: icon
items.title: Icon
items.description: Иконка Hugeicons Stroke Rounded в четырёх канонических размерах: 12 — галочка чекбокса, 16 — контент, 20 — навигация, 32 — иллюстрация пустого состояния. Всегда currentColor и aria-hidden.
items.author: Sergey Orshak
items.docs: Требует токены Cubby UI: npx shadcn@latest add kenetatuse80471-creator/cubby-ui/tokens — и импорт cubby-tokens.css и cubby-theme.css после @import "tailwindcss".

items.name: modal
items.title: Modal
items.description: A blocking dialog on Base UI: scrim, header and footer cut off by dividers, the body as the only scrolling area, and five widths from 460 to 940.
items.author: Sergey Orshak
items.docs: Focus trap, Escape, a press on the scrim, focus return and the body scroll lock (scrollbar compensated) come from Base UI Dialog. `title` and `closeLabel` are required — the dialog is named by its title and the × by its label. Compose with `ModalTrigger` and `ModalClose`, or drive it with `open` / `onOpenChange`. Needs the Cubby UI tokens: npx shadcn@latest add kenetatuse80471-creator/cubby-ui/tokens — then import cubby-tokens.css and cubby-theme.css after @import "tailwindcss".

items.name: snackbar
items.title: Snackbar
items.description: One snackbar at a time on Base UI Toast: undo lives 5 seconds, a quiet confirmation 3, an error until it is dismissed by hand.
items.author: Sergey Orshak
items.docs: Wrap the app in `SnackbarProvider` and call `useSnackbar().notify({ kind, message, actionLabel, onAction, closeLabel })`. A new snackbar displaces the one on screen — the queue never piles up — and every timer pauses while the viewport is hovered or holds focus. `Snackbar` without a toast object renders the same bar statically. Needs the Cubby UI tokens: npx shadcn@latest add kenetatuse80471-creator/cubby-ui/tokens — then import cubby-tokens.css and cubby-theme.css after @import "tailwindcss".

items.name: context-action-menu
items.title: ContextActionMenu
items.description: The row-level «…» menu on Base UI Menu: 210 wide, items 28 high, the destructive ones last in their own group behind a divider.
items.author: Sergey Orshak
items.docs: Pass `actions` and the required `ariaLabel`; the default trigger is a text IconButton with «…». Opening by click, arrow keys, Enter, Escape, typeahead and the focus returning to the trigger are Base UI. The `Menu*` parts are exported as well, so the same surface can be composed into any popover. Needs the Cubby UI tokens: npx shadcn@latest add kenetatuse80471-creator/cubby-ui/tokens — then import cubby-tokens.css and cubby-theme.css after @import "tailwindcss".
